sources.title: hindsight-ai/hs-decide-1-flash · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: hs-decide-1-flash is a 0.8B decision model for Hindsight. You give it a state and one or more typed questions about it, and it returns a probability for every answer option in a single forward pass, with no generated text.

sources.title: nanoandrew4/hs-decide-1-flash-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: hs-decide-1-flash-bf16.gguf: bf16 weights, 1.5 GiB. Serves the model over POST /v1/systemone (noul / score / choice, multi-question supported). Quantization note: Q8_0 was A/B-gated against the official vLLM plugin math on 20 fixed payloads and failed 14 of them (max probability diff 7.85e-3); bf16 passes 19/20 (max 1.40e-3, argmax identical everywhere). Ship bf16. Downloads last month - GGUF ...
